auditor_patel: Hi team — auditor here. We're compiling SOC 2 evidence for the Nov 2 incident. Observed inconsistent X-RateLimit-* headers and a burst of 401/403s + some 429s for certain tenants. Need: log slices showing the rate-limit headers, auth failure traces, and HSM/KMS rotation timestamps (chain-of-custody). Please advise minimal repro steps, exact S3 export paths, and expected timeline for delivery.

anna: thanks — we can pull api gateway logs + keystore access logs + hsm audit. can you confirm exact window you care about? also any customer IDs to prioritize? :eyes:

auditor_patel: window = 2025-11-02T14:05:00Z -> 2025-11-02T14:20:00Z. priority tenant = cust_789. Also need proof there was no key material change outside the scheduled rotation. please include key rotation job IDs and audit entries.

maya: oncall here — background: we ran a scheduled HSM rotation that started 2025-11-02T13:58:43Z and finished 2025-11-02T14:02:11Z. config update was pushed ~14:03Z. I'll attach the rotation job ID. Might overlap with your window.

liam: I can extract the slices. sample query i'll run against the logs index:```sql
-- elasticsearch-ish pseudo
POST /_search
{ "query": { "bool": { "must": [ { "range": { "@timestamp": { "gte": "2025-11-02T14:05:00Z", "lte": "2025-11-02T14:20:00Z" } } }, { "term": { "tenant_id": "cust_789" } } ] } }, "size": 10000 }
```
I'll also filter for headers present: `headers.X-RateLimit-Limit`, `headers.X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and status codes 401/403/429.

jake: customer success — cust_789 reported latency and unexpected auth errors around 14:07-14:10Z. billing noticed a token spike for that tenant due to retries. they need a short narrative + log excerpts to send to their compliance team.

anna: plan: 1) extract api_gateway logs (jsonl) for window and tenant, 2) keystore access logs (keystore-auth.log), 3) hsm/audit export (hsm_rotation_audit.csv), 4) chain_of_custody.txt + manifest.json + gpg signature. I'll upload to our evidence bucket and post link here.

deploy-bot: log-export-job #527 queued -> s3://eng-sec-evidence/tmp/527/ (export will include api_logs.jsonl)

maya: repro steps (minimal):
1) replay a request sequence that triggers auth path with stale token header + same X-Request-ID pattern
2) send 5 concurrent requests with same tenant and missing cache key to emulate retries
curl snippet:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <stale-token>" -H "X-Tenant-Id: cust_789" -H "X-Request-ID: replay-123" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
```
Filter on response headers to capture `X-RateLimit-*` and `X-Auth-Error`.

liam: when I run extraction i'll include a short grep/jq command to slice header fields. example:
```
jq -r '"\(.@timestamp) \(.tenant_id) \(.status) \(.headers[\"X-RateLimit-Remaining\"]) \(.headers[\"X-RateLimit-Limit\"])"' api_logs.jsonl | grep cust_789
```
I'll also annotate any entries where `auth_event.reason` exists.

anna: expected artefact locations (will upload by EOD UTC):
- s3://eng-sec-evidence/soc2/2025-11-02/incident-2945678901/api_gateway_logs.jsonl
- s3://eng-sec-evidence/soc2/2025-11-02/incident-2945678901/keystore_auth.log
- s3://eng-sec-evidence/soc2/2025-11-02/incident-2945678901/hsm_rotation_audit.csv
- s3://eng-sec-evidence/soc2/2025-11-02/incident-2945678901/manifest.json
- s3://eng-sec-evidence/soc2/2025-11-02/incident-2945678901/manifest.json.sig (gpg)
I'm adding retention statements that map to control CC-RET-01 (retention and deletion policy). link: https://internal.redwood.ai/policies/retention#cc-ret-01

auditor_patel: we need explicit timestamps for key rotation events inside the HSM audit and the key IDs used to sign tokens (kid). please include `kid` mapping and whether any `kid` changed between 13:55Z and 14:05Z. also need sampling proof that access logs are complete for that window.

maya: hsm rotation job id = rotation-20251102-13-58-43, affected keyset = keystore-main-v2, rotated key IDs: k_2025_11_02_a, k_2025_11_02_b. old active kid before rotation: k_2025_10_10_x. we'll include the audit rows showing `event=rotate start|complete` with exact timestamps.

liam: i've started the extract; uploading partials to s3://eng-sec-evidence/tmp/527/ now. ETA full bundle 3h. I'll also produce a small CSV that correlates request_id -> auth_error -> rate_limit_headers for quick review.

anna: manifest will include SHA256 checksums and a signed chain_of_custody. evidence retention window is standard SOC2 retention (3 years) per policy doc. if auditor needs an additional notarization let us know.

auditor_patel: thanks. please include a short one-paragraph timeline and a statement whether the HSM rotation was planned and whether token signing keys were rolled in a way that could cause 401s. we will mark this as high-priority evidence request.

jake: i'll prepare the customer-facing summary once anna posts the artefacts.
